params.Title: The BrawlWiki
params.content: [[file:BrawlWiki_logo.png|left]][[BrawlWiki]] was an encyclopedia for ''[[Free Realms]]'' [[:category:weapon|weapons]] founded by Roland Spore. It was merged with the ''Free Realms'' wikia before closing in 2013.
